Considering the risk constraints and using genetic algorithm, the asset allocation strategy which gives the final maximum wealth under the risk constraints is obtained

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on the Effect of Subjects of Stimulation & Restriction Vacancy on Performance of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Subjects of stimulation and restriction affect the governance mechanisms of listed companies and finally affect their operating performance. Based on the ownership concentration and ownership structure, the text makes an overall statistical analysis and makes a relevant sample analysis to the ownership structure and the operating performance of Chinese listed companies. Moreover, the text also makes a statistical analysis to the relation between the independent director and the operating performance

articleTitle: Discussion on the Practical Significance of Western Optimal Taxation Theory
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Ever since the reformation and opening of China in the late seventies, especially with the introduction of western economics theories into China, western taxation system, including the optimal taxation theory has been gradually drawn attention to. However as an Nobel prize winning theory, it is not as close to reality as to be applied into a guidance principle in practice. In fact, current studies on the western optimal taxation theory and their preliminary applications in China, as shown in literatures, have remarkable deficiency. Here we report some systematic comments and analysis on the western optimal taxation theory and the latest research processes by western scholars, based mainly on original publications. We illustrate that, as a deduction from assumptions, the optimal taxation theory only applies to a strictly supposed circumstance. In other words, without certain qualifications, conclusions in the theory couldn't be drawn; or different conclusions would be made in various conditions. Both the proportional rule and anti-elasticity rule in the system of optimal merchandise taxation and the linear model in optimal income taxation theory share the same disadvantage when facing the reality. Therefore, any theorem in optimal taxation theory is not universal and general; on the contrary, as an individual conclusion with special premise, it shouldn't be regarded as the direct and specific guidance to a nation's taxation reforming. Taxation reformation in China is most special case with extremely complicated variables in it economic system and historical, social and political characteristics. So finally we propose that especially caution must be taken in the course of applying western optimal taxation theory in China

articleTitle: Gender Equity Evaluation System Based on the Process and Outcomes: Study on the QOC Services System of FP at China's County Level
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the gender equity conception, the gender equity evaluation system including concept, framework, and indicators was built in this research with the existing research of equity evaluation system for public health and evaluation system for QOC services referenced, and literature review, group discussion, in-depth interview, and experts judging methodology included, as well as the system analysis for QOC services of FP at China's county level adopted. The evaluation system were applied into Juchao District in eastern China, and the results showed that: (1) the gender equity status in institutional behaviors of township level is better than that of other institutions; (2) the scores on the protection of the realistic RH rights and interests of service providers are generally higher than that of strategic RH rights and interest, and (3) the service clients' have better ideology of right-protection, but the improvement need to be made on responsibility-shared and interest-shared; (4) men have lower responsiveness and RH status than that of women. The application indicated the feasibility, but the stability and the scope for applicability need to be improved

articleTitle: Effects of Stickiness of Knowledge Transferring across Borders on Choice of International Entrepreneurial Modes
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: It's a strategic and urgent issue to choose a proper entry mode for international entrepreneurial entities. And knowledge transferring across borders is necessary to international entrepreneurial performance with the knowledge economy coming. While stickiness of knowledge transferring across borders has a critical effect on decision making of international entrepreneurial modes. Firstly this research does a mathematical analysis by cost minimization approach. Then on the base of theoretical results and surveying in 122 international entrepreneurial entities located in China, this research empirically finds that stickiness of knowledge transferring across borders actually affects choice of international entrepreneurial modes. Also this study result shows industry is significant variable to decision making of international entrepreneurial modes while the cultural distance is insignificant to choice of modes.

articleTitle: Anexplanation of the Regulation Failure in the Taxicab Industry - Tested on the Case of the Taxi Regulation in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: It is unsuccessful to regulate the whole taxi industry in Beijing, one of the evidences is the large difference between the result and objective. This article analyses the difference from the appearance and evolution of the regulation, and explain the reasons of regulation failure

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Evolvement Rules of Manufacturing Enterprises' Capability in China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly analyzed capability system of manufacturing enterprise and took enterprises in Zhejiang province where has comparatively advanced manufacturing industry in China as samples. Then the paper analyzed the relation between capabilities and enterprises' performance through studying the change of capabilities in different enterprise with higher-performance, increasing-performance and decreasing-performance. Also the paper summarized evolvement rules of manufacturing enterprises' capability. The rules can offer academic reference for dynamic programming of capability and forming of continuous competitive advantage

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Influential Factors of Underpricing in China Listed Companies' Seasoned Equity Offerings
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Seasoned equity offerings are main equity financing means. The paper analyses the determinants of seasoned equity offerings' underpricing in China's securities market empirically. The analysis indicates: the average degree of underpricing is 7.15% in seasoned equity offerings, and it present fall trend year after year. The empirical studies offer support for it is the determinants of the underpricing degree in seasoned equity offerings that overallotment option, EPS and controlling shareholders' equity proportion are. This paper also points forward the thoughts and policy suggestions on improving the pricing measures according to analysis results

articleTitle: Effects of the Propensity of the Largest Shareholder on Capital Structure of Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Using a sample of 2278 leverage ratios of 1139 companies listed in Chinese A share market, this paper first examined the relationship between the degree of control of the largest shareholder on decision making and the capital structure of listed companies in China via empirical test. Then, based on the empirical result, the reason why this result formed was construed through analyzing the value propensity of the largest shareholder and its influence on the debt ratio. The empirical analysis indicates that the debt ratio of listed companies is negatively related to both the share proportion and the illiquid share proportion held by the largest shareholder, that is, the higher the share proportion and illiquid share proportion held by the largest shareholder, the lower the debt ratio is. From theoretic analysis, in such a stock market like that in China where stocks are issued with a premium and ownership is segmented, equity financing under the condition of the highly concentrated ownership possessed by the largest shareholder conduces to magnify the equity value of the largest shareholder without facing the threat of takeover from stock market and restriction from creditors. In this way, equity financing is preferred, and so the debt ratio is lowered

articleTitle: A Hybrid Inference Framework for Model Selection
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A hybrid inference framework is presented in which the aim is to select decision models through natural language in knowledge-based decision support system. In situations in which the rules that determine a system are uncertain and incomplete, the knowledge elicitation, maintenance and update of the rule-based system can be the problematic tasks. In such a situation, it has been found that a hybrid case-based and rule-based reasoning framework can provide a more effective and accurate means of performing such selection than other statistical methods and models. The hybrid framework results in capturing knowledge in context by storage of the case that prompted a new rule to be added, which aims at the unwanted side effects associated with typical rule reasoning system. This framework has been used to determine the inventory models in the decision support system. The results obtained from the experiment are presented with the both efficiency-improving and accuracy-improving

articleTitle: Study on the Organizational Innovation Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The process of the business enterprise organization's development presents the characteristics of complexity and diversity, and the chaos exists inevitably in this process. We should carry on organizational innovation positively to deal with this situation. The enterprise organization is one kind of complex system, and organizational innovation is a special process in the process of organization's development. The system of organizational innovation is also a complex system. The chaos theory is the research in the general rule of complex system. It has the certain instructive function to the complex process of organizational innovation. And the critical state of self-organization in chaos has important significance of practical application to control the "innovation's quantity" in the process of organizational innovation.

articleTitle: The Research on Competitiveness of Various Industries in Xi'an High-Tech Industry Zone
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we report an evaluation model for the competitiveness of Xi'an high-tech industry zone based on Michael Porter's theory of competitive advantage. We set up a competitiveness evaluation index system, employed SPSS statistical software, analyzed and compared different industries in the high-tech zone based on a "key factor" calculation model. The results and analyses were found to be useful for improving the competitiveness of various industries in the high-tech zone

articleTitle: A Study of Measurement Models for Digital Divide of China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology in recent years, "digital divide" has already become a heat concern that attracts close attention from governments, enterprises and academic circles in the world. And it is influencing on every aspect in the society and gradually reshaping the structure of this world. This paper, based on a deep analysis of the relevant domestic and international research on "digital divide", probes into the content and methods of models for measuring digital divide from two perspectives measurement indices and measurement colonies, and a few measurement models of "digital divide" in accordance with different regional units and different citizens. Strategies are proposed for the government to promote the digital economy and fill up the "digital divide" in China

articleTitle: Strategic Choose to the Technological Innovation of Firms in Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the two-stage game model of A-J, by introducing the variable of duopoly firm's distance attenuation coefficient and perfect information dynamic gambling, this paper discussed the change of duopoly Nash equilibrium output in output stage in the situation of independent innovation, cooperative innovation and imitative innovation, and compared the influence of firm's technological innovation strategy on the firm's innovation investment, the output and the profit. This provided a theoretical basis for the industrial cluster firms when choosing technological innovation strategy

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Technology Development Strategy in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Future energy technology development strategy plays an important role in guaranteeing the realization of economic development requirements proposed by the 11th five-year plan in China. This paper builds a MESSAGE energy-system model to formulate the future energy technology choices and strategy for Shanghai, which is a metropolis with great energy consumption and needs. The MESSAGE model structure is briefly described firstly. The overall objective is to fulfill various demands by the utilization of technologies and resources with the minimal total discounted system costs. The model incorporates and explores three cases for the evolution of the energy system from 2005 to 2030, enabling the insight to be gained into different energy development choices. To overcome the limitation of MESSAGE, the future costs of all technologies are assumed uncertain and to be distributed according to the log-normal distribution. Also the technologies are related through the structure of energy system in MESSAGE. Besides, endogenous learning is defined as a function of cumulative experience measured by cumulative installed capacity. Electricity generation is taken as an example to analyze the results in three different cases. The analysis indicates that technological dynamics produce a wide range of different emergent energy systems but can be considered to be approximately equivalent with respect to optimal criteria.

articleTitle: Simulated Study on Captain's Navigating Capability
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This study, using the navigating simulator manufactured by TRANSAS for big ship, explored the navigating capability of offing captains under 8 conditions, based on the indexes of the number of collisions, their heart rates, etc. The results suggested that the number of collisions and the heart rate were significantly affected by the navigating capability. Results of this research were expected to provide both theoretical and technical support for the safety education, skill training, selection and evaluation of captains in China, thus improving the core competence of shipping enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of the Environmental Impacts on the Tourism Destination by Tourism
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Tourism is closely linked with environmental protection. It is significant to study on the impacts to the tourism environment. This article first defines the tourism environment based on the previous researches and puts forward a set of environmental impact index system including sightseeing environment, living environment, natural environment and social environment. It then uses factor analysis method to elicit an integrated score and analyses the actuality of environmental impacts on different regions in China through the experimental research. The results have realistic guidance to tourism development planning in China. Compared to the former studies of evaluation index system on environmental impacts, this index system uses comparative indicators, which is more intuitional and more operable. The data used in this study come from public data resources and the method used is more objective

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on Relationship of Research Expenditure and Education Cost
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed why research expenditures should be numbered into educational cost, and then provided quantitative method for measurement what proportion of research expenditure can be reckoned into educational cost. Empirical study has been done on the data of eighteen famous universities selected from China and proven the practical application of their method

articleTitle: The Dynamics of Competitive Advantage: An Integrative Framework
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper provides an integrative framework for acquisitions of competitive advantage of the firm. The issue of competitive advantage is of vital in the field of strategic management, representing how to build up the theory of firm strategy to compete over competitors in the long run. Based on analyses of competitive advantage from multiple theories of industrial organization, resource-based view and institution-based perspective, an integrative framework of the dynamics of competitive advantage for acquisition is normatively deduced to be composed of three successive processes of generation, maintenance and sustainability respectively. The propositions are postulated for normative studies according to analyses of the three kinds of the mainstream theories of firm strategy. Contrasted against emerging Chinese firm strategy, labeling as Go Out since 1999, the framework is of significant for Chinese firms going globally at present

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Endogenous Optimal Currency Area Theory Using a Gravity Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The startup of Euro makes optimal currency area theory cannot be immersed in discussions of "beforehand" standards, otherwise to change to the research of "afterwards" effects of currency union's. It is found that "beforehand" standards provided by original optimal currency area theory can be convergent gradually after the setting up of currency union after the research about effects of currency union, which is called optimal currency area's "endogenous". Based on Mundell's optimal currency area theory, this paper using a gravity model evaluate the effects of convergent standards in Maastricht Treaty to endogenous optimal currency area of EU, through selecting a panel date from 14 countries of EU. The results show: interests, finance policies, convergence of debts are important to the effects of endogenous optimal currency of EU

articleTitle: Governance Structure and Operating Performance of Initial Public Offerings in China: A New Explanation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: We investigate the potential reason of decline in operating performance of Chinese initial public offerings (IPO), using a data set of 738 firms for the period 1996-2000. We find that, growth rate of investment and sales are unrelated with governance structure, and Chinese IPOs have had better post-issue performance may be more likely to invest. We also find relationship between identity of ownership and post-issue operating performance. These findings suggest that the agency hypothesis that governance change may induce an inefficient investment and sales doesn't work well in Chinese IPOs, and the motivation for going public is fairly to finance investment. Data envelopment analysis (DEA), a non-parametric frontier technique, is introduced to estimate the potential relation among governance structure, investment and sales growth, instead of using econometric methods only

articleTitle: A Multiobjective Optimization Model for Packing Proposals in Large-Scale R&D Project Review
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve the packing proposals problem in large-scale R&D project review, a-nonlinear 0-1 integer programming model with multiobjective is presented. The first objective is to minimize the quantity difference between the number of proposals for each package and the average number of proposals that peer reviewers would like to review. The second objective is to minimize the probability that proposals belong to the same organization be packed into one package. A weighted sum method is applied to treat multiple objectives. Then, a genetic algorithm with sequence encoding and PMX crossover is developed to solve this model. Finally, a numerical experiment designed to simulate the proposal packing process of NSFC is described to illustrate the use of the proposed method

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Customer Classification Based on Reliability
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Customer retention is an important target for the firm's strategic of customer relationship management in condition of the escalated market competition. The customer classification is the foundation of customer retention policies. So far, the management literature covering the customer classification has almost exhibited a quite general way based on the lifetime-profitability (revenue). But the research results indicate that a substantial positive correlation would not exist between the lifetime and the profitability (revenue). This article takes a different perspective and advances a new classification measure based on the Customer Relationship Reliability, and describes in detail how to use this measure to classify the firm's customers, and also proposes some suitable approaches for managing the customers in different segmentation. The validity of the new classification model has been proved by a successful application in a Chinese supermarket, JUHAO

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Technological Advancement Effect in the Defence Industry
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve the striding development, technology also needs the striding development. Science and technology is regarded as the main strength in the striding development of the defence industry. Beginning with the studying of the principle of technological striding; the paper concludes that the technological striding development is a kind of non-continuous development. Some suggestions on the improving the technological advancement effect in the defence industry have been put forward in level, key points and basis

Author Keywords: The advancement of science and technology

articleTitle: Study on the Technology Innovation Competence: From the Perceptive of Knowledge Integration
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of technology, knowledge has become the most important strategic resource in the worldwide economic globalization. Knowledge and its application have turned to be the source of power for enterprise continuing competence of competition. Therefore, knowledge integration is the key to improving the corporate technology innovation. This paper mainly makes an analysis on the mechanism of the knowledge integration and the impacts of knowledge integration on enterprise's technology innovation, and finally discussing ways to improve innovation through integration

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Impact of IS Sourcing Type on IS Service Capability
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper was to examine the effectiveness of information system sourcing from the perspective of information system service capability. Since system service capability was a difficult variable to be described and examined, the two factors as service quality and maintenance costs were used to evaluate it. Questionnaire was designed, and MANCOVA was used to examine the relationship of variables. We empirically found that there were differences not only in system service quality among in-sourced, outsourced and cooperated systems, but also in maintenance costs. The results suggested that outsourcing may not always be the optimal selection for reducing costs and increasing efficiency over system lifetime. Cooperative type was sometimes good for increasing IS service capability as the system grew older. Companies should consider the characteristics of IS sourcing type and its relationship with service capability, and the difference between TPS and DSS. Perhaps this paper can give some advice on which sourcing type should be selected based on system service capability

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Effectiveness of Audit Committee - Evidence Based on Audit Fee of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking Chinese A-share listed companies as sample and using the regression analysis method, this paper researches the corporate governance effect of audit committee by examining the relationships between the audit fees and relevant factors. Through analyzing the correlative data, the paper finds that the audit fees are significantly associated with board independence, the number of independent directors, the number of insider directors, and other some factors. It finds further that the relationships are related to the formation of audit committee. The findings support that audit committee improves company's internal control system and promotes external auditor independence, as well as supports the purchase of the higher-quality audit services. At the same time, some interesting results are found and discussed. At last, it points out the conclusion and limitation in this research, and offers a kind of idea and method for the similar research

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Relationship between Free Float Ratio and P/E Ratio in Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: P/E ratio is an important index for each stock in different stock markets, but few empirical researches of P/E ratio in Chinese stock market have been published till now. By the latest nonparametric model specification method, this paper finds a linear relationship between P/E ratio and the reciprocal of free float ratio (RFFR) of individual stocks in China's Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges on the cross-section data of listed companies. This kind of linear relationship represents a typical characteristic of Chinese stock market and furthermore, the linear coefficient of RFFR in the semi-parameter model provides a more convincible estimation to compute the liquidity premium of individual stocks than the coefficient in a line model when controlling the influences of assets and liabilities

articleTitle: Strategic Human Resource Management and Social Capital: Evidence from People's Republic of China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the social capital theory be introduced into business domain, the concept of organizational social capital (OSC) occurred. OSC can be the mediator between the HRM and organizational competitive advantage. The existent literatures reveal that social intercourse and connection among the internal actors attach great importance to the key success factors of the organization. The purpose of this study is to investigate the OSC effect on the SHRM improving the performance. This study analyzed the data from 640 investigation questionnaires of 42 corporations, employing the multiple regression analysis, investigate the relationship among HRM, internal/external SC, employee social capital, executive SC and OSC, and organizational performance. The results show that, organizational HRM is associated with the accumulation of social capital, and positively affects organizational performance

articleTitle: Survey on Residents' Willingness to Pay for Compensation of City Forest Ecologic Benefit
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The contingent valuation method is used here to investigate the WTP (willingness to pay) of residents on city forest purification. Survey results show that 66% of the residents think that the quality of air is better. As high as 96% of the residents revealed positive attitudes towards strengthening city forest input. 70.5% of the residents are willing to donate 33.2 yuanmiddota<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. And more than 80% of the residents are willing to contribute 5.5 hourmiddota<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. Willingness to pay mainly depends on such factors as family income, education level and the time of doing physical exercises outside. At present, investment in city forest compensation is still limited. Above all, putting economical compensatory on city forest must be accord with residents' willingness to pay

articleTitle: Framework on High-performance Leadership in Knowledge-based Companies
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: High-performance companies are a prerequisite for growth in today's knowledge-based economy. High-performance leadership is a critical success factor for companies as much as for any organization. High-performance leadership is synthesis which including skill, behaviors and strategies vision of the leaders. Based on the attributes of high-performance leadership, this study proposes a framework on high-performance leadership in knowledge-based companies. The framework shows that leadership skill, behaviors and strategies vision are the factors of high-performance leadership, they can influence the organization performance through integrating high-performance leadership. While cultural context also play role by effect others factors, it is infiltrative factor

articleTitle: The Optimum Brand Extension Strategy in Monopolized Target Market
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Brand extension, or the use of established brand name to enter new product category, is a very popular branding strategy. According to the quality model reflecting the vertical differentiation of the product, this article derived the optimum brand extension strategy pattern of the brand-extension firm in the monopolized target market. The result showed: It is not always the positive correlation between the brand lever force and the brand extension performance, but influenced by the target market type. Specifically, there is inverse-U relationship between the brand lever force and the brand extension performance in the monopolized target market, not the monotonicity. Firms with the medium-sized brand lever force prefer to extend their brands to markets that are monopolized and maybe are "far" from their original product line. Other conclusions and lessons were also obtained from the model

articleTitle: Research on Implicit Cycle of Volatility in Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this article, we analyze the characteristics of the implicit cycle of volatility in Chinese stock market by the theory of frequency spectrum. Through searching literature, we know the fact that the study of volatility in Chinese stock market always concentrate their attention on existence of volatility and there is lack of research on the implicit cycle characteristic in the market volatility. In recent years, some scholars also study the volatility in Chinese stock market and hold that there is implicit cycle of volatility in Chinese stock market, but don't provide the statistical test about peak value. The essence of implicit cycle in volatility is the performance of the low efficient market. Therefore, in this article, we establish the periodgram analysis model, and apply the window spectrum estimate of the power spectrum to analyze the volatility of Shanghai's stock price index and Shenzhen's. We also study the existence on implicit cycle of volatility in Chinese stock market in order to determine the improvement degree about Chinese stock market's efficiency. In this article, we study the implicit cycle of volatility in Chinese stock market by the stock index. The volatility of stock market is referring to the volatility that corresponded to the stock index. The author selects the day closing quotation index of Shanghai stock exchange composite index and of Shenzhen stock exchange component index as data sample and the data sector is from January 4, 1999 to December 13, 2005, amount to 1668 trading day. We each establish the two index's day return rate's percentage sequence. The data sequence doesn't have the tendency and seasonal characteristic. We apply the SPECTRA process of the SAS software (spectral analysis process) to determine the sequence's implicit cycle and provide the statistical test about peak value. So we obtain some researches output. We hold that there does not exist the implicit cycle of volatility in Chinese stock market. From this research we know that the Chinese stock market efficiency obtains the enhancement and the volatility structure have a greater change than several year ago. We also believe that the higher volatility in Chinese stock market is may caused by the centralized and fierce new message and by the worse market absorbency in the shock of message. Both lead to the stock price's volatility

articleTitle: A Study of Stock Equity Value Pricing Based on the Option Theory - A Case Study of Xuzhou Engineering and Technology Corporation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on an analysis of three traditional approaches to value appraisal and their limitations, the paper puts forward a theory that takes the enterprise stock equity as a combination of rights and obligations and which uses the option pricing model to price the enterprise's stock equity value based on the decomposition of each of the enterprise's financial basic element into any of the factors of option pricing model. Then this paper takes Xuzhou Engineering and Technology Corporation as a case and makes a positivistic analysis of the theory mentioned above, and points out both the applicability and the limitation of option in the process of stock equity pricing. It aims to resolve a long-unsettled difficult problem that the implicit value cannot be appraised rationally by traditional approaches, and to provide a new idea for the enterprise in value drive management.

articleTitle: Product Market Competition, Shareholder Governance and Firm Value: The Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper explores the interaction between product market competition and shareholder governance in transitional economy in China and investigates the influence of ultimate controller of listed companies on this relationship. The research finds that there is a complementary influence between product market competition and shareholder governance when the strength of competition goes beyond certain level. What's more, this relationship is stronger in companies ultimately controlled by the private than by the state. Finally, we conclude that the relationship between product market competition and shareholder governance is not simply monotonic

articleTitle: Optimum Harmonic Number of Clusters and Best Clustering in Fuzzy C- means
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: We construct a harmonic function (v<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ZS</sub>) of criteria on the basis of intra- and inter-distances in the fuzzy c means (FCM). Iterative self-organizing data analysis technique algorithm (ISODATA) and genetic algorithm (GA) are nested to form a genetic self-organizing data analysis technique algorithm (GA-ISODATA), which is used to conduct the optimal computing of FCM. Compared to other methods, our method can be used not only to do optimal clustering but also to yield the optimum harmonic number of clusters and the corresponding optimal clustering without artificial interference according to the clustering criteria, given a preset number of clustering. GA-ISODATA has a wide application. When other cluster criteria are adopted, only the fitness function is needed to be modified

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Match of Corporation Capabilities and Value Innovation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper makes use of value analysis and vector analysis methods to investigate the sufficient condition for a corporation to obtain its competitive advantages. Value innovation is a search of new value combination and the corporation capability that satisfies the value innovation needs is capabilities bundle, they both can be expressed as value vectors in a three-dimensional value space. The dynamic match of value fix vectors and capabilities bundle value vector is the sufficient condition to obtain and maintain a corporation's competitive advantages, and this dynamic match could be achieved by adjusting the corporation capabilities bundle and value combination

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Gain-sharing Percentage for Technological Innovators
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Many scholars claimed that the enterprises should proceed gain-sharing plan for technological innovators in the purpose of inspiring enthusiasm of them. In order to maximize net income from innovations, this paper points out the optimum gain-sharing percentage by mathematical models which simulate the relation between innovators and enterprises and game theory, and calculates out the sum of gain-sharing percentages for all technological, innovators in an innovative project is 25%

articleTitle: The Simulation Research on Inventory Control of Distribution System Based on Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The distribution system has been the most important part in the management of supply chain. The way to reduce the inventory cost considering keeping the customer level is the hotspot in the industry and academe. The paper tries to apply the theory of customer segmentation to the inventory control strategy in distribution system. Firstly, we promote an amendatory formula of customer service level based on customer segmentation, and then erect an inventory control simulation model based on customer segmentation in a distribution system. In this way, we can find an effective inventory optimized control strategy to reduce the cost, and at the same time to enhance the satisfaction of important customers

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Performance of China's Cross-border Mergers & Acquisitions Activity
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper adopts accounting-based and event study approaches to analyze the performance of Chinese enterprises' cross-border M&A by focusing on 27 cases of reverse cross-border M&A in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock market from 2000 to 2005. The study finds that after transnational M&A there is a remarkable trend of the profitability and growth of the Chinese enterprises, which first falls and then rises. This trend shows that it is a long-term hard work to improve the performance of reverse transnational M&A, which aims to obtain the foreign advanced technology and resources. On the other hand, the transnational M&A conducted by Chinese listed corporations are well accepted by the stock market and bring the shareholders the effect of market wealth. But there is some information leakage to a certain extent in the stock market, which indicates that the stock market is a weak efficient market

articleTitle: Empirical Research on RMB Equilibrium Exchange Rate - Analysis and Forecast Based on Multivariable VAR Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the implementation of the new mechanism of RMB exchange rate in 2005, its revaluation has been anticipated. The issue of RMB exchange rate still is the focal point of various circles. How much space there is for the revaluation, and how far is it away from the equilibrium level? These questions were explored in this paper through application of the new approach of studying equilibrium exchange rate - the behavior equilibrium exchange rate (BEER) analysis method. Also the RMB's exchange rate level was discussed and the trend of RMB equilibrium exchange rate was forecasted under the pulse function in the VAR model system, and accordingly the corresponding policy proposals were put forward

articleTitle: The Black-box Model to Distinguish between Motivator and Amotivator
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Motivated employees are essential for today's business to adapt to the fast-paced environment. However, motivating employees is arguably the most complex in practice. In this paper, our aim is to discuss the distinction between motivator and amotivator. The literature was undertaken to review on the differences between motivator and amotivator solely from the perspective of job satisfaction or objective performance. Psychologists pay primarily attention on individual's subjective feeling in heart, such as job satisfaction and need. However job satisfaction is based on self-reported scores from the Motivation and Job Satisfaction Survey. On the other hand, some researchers focus on the evaluation of those variables, such as organizational effectiveness and individual performance. However they neglected largely the side of psychology. Motivation cannot be seen nor can it be measured directly, but motivation can be inferred in terms of behavioral or outcome changes brought in by internal or external stimulus. Therefore, this paper introduced a unifying black-box model by which through comparing the measured outcome to previous one, we can infer whether the outside stimulus is a motivator or not. Based on the above model, we proposed that the distinguishing principles between motivator and amotivator should incorporate both job satisfaction and individual performance. If any one of the variables is missing or negative, then motivation will not occur or will diminish in the long run. By applying the proposed distinguishing principle, the continuum pattern between motivator and demotivator was presented, respectively positive motivator, negative motivator, hygiene factor and demotivator. The result of this paper offered practitioners a valid and useful framework for making best of limiting resources to reach the maximum utility of motivation, so as to maintain a long-term, high level of employee motivation

articleTitle: Research of Attribution of Service Failures and Response Model Based on Customer
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Service failures are so inevitable because of the essential of service that it is indispensable to bring in service recovery. This paper provides an in-depth study on customer loss, attribution and response mode of service failures. Firstly, the characters and extent of customer loss are studied. It's the base of carrying out rationality and fairness of service recovery. Then, the research of customer attribution about service failures is done. Finally, customer responses model about service failures is pointed out. Based on the research, the efficiency of preventing and eliminating adverse effect on customer can be improved. It also makes managers of enterprises take cognizance of the importance and essentiality of service recovery and then take steps actively to recover service failures

articleTitle: Implementing Relationship Marketing in the Luxury Sector
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Relationship marketing has been gaining momentum as business entities realize that short-term sales/transaction orientation has several pitfalls for building customer loyalty and continued patronage. Relationship marketing has the potential to improve marketing productivity. What is the previous research on relationship marketing in the luxury sector of China? Which are the various techniques of relationship marketing practiced in luxury companies? How do these practices correlate with the performance of such luxury companies? These and related issues are the focus of this empirical investigation. The methodology used in the study consisted of a survey among 98 luxury companies in the northeast of China and the findings of the survey conducted among the luxury companies are analyzed. Furthermore the paper provides a discussion on the nature and scope of relationship marketing and proposes some recommendations to assist luxury firms in China in the implementation of this new marketing concept. Finally the concluding note of this study suggests suitable techniques, which can be used to make the concept of relationship marketing successful among the luxury sector in China

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Cognitive Variables of Organization Members on Information System Benefits
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This study is based on the theory of organizational behavior and from the perspective of the organization overall information system benefits. Reviewing the studies of technology acceptance model, innovation diffusion theory and self-efficacy, this study summarizes the major contributions and limitations, establishes the new direction. From the perspective of cognition and behavior, this study introduces the intermediate information system benefits, designs a theoretical model, collects data with questionnaires, checks up reliability and validity with structural equation models, and analyzes the methods. The results of the study give some guidance theoretically and practically

articleTitle: Optimization Model on Sensitivity Analyses for Additive MADM
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Since decision variables like criteria value and weighting factors can be influenced by subjective and objective variations, sensitivity analyses are crucial for the effectiveness of decision support systems. In this paper, a systematic analytical approach is demonstrated, by which sensitivity indicators are derived for each criteria weight. Furthermore, an optimization model is presented to determine the stability intervals, in which the ranking order of a predetermined number of alternatives remains unchanged. The sensitivity analyses are illustrated by a case study on the evaluation of various emission reduction alternatives for industrial surface coating

articleTitle: A Comparative Panel Data Estimation on Technology Spillover Effects of FDI and Import in China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: By using China's 30 provincial panel data during the period 1996~2002, this paper aims at taking a comparative estimation on technology spillover effects of FDI and import on China's indigenous firms. Our panel data estimation results demonstrate that both FDI and import are major technology spillover sources for China's domestic firms. However, in general technology spillover effect of FDI is more significant than import since their technology spillover mechanism differs essentially, and also technology spillover effects greatly depend on absorptive capability, which is measured by both degree of openness and human capital accumulation

articleTitle: Enterprise Software System Development Based on Management Pattern Components
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many deficiencies in business software system development. One of the most important is the developed system can't change adaptively when the business upper management pattern change. For different patterns, management software system is different too. It's necessary to analyze the main influencing factors of management pattern and their effects. To design and realize management system agilely, we try to divide management pattern into multiple levels and components. At the same time, we may divide business software system into many subsystems and extract the common features of the different patterns, then construct a referenced system model of every subsystem. For different management pattern, we may amend its concrete management pattern feature components, and add it to the referenced system model, and then assemble the subsystems into management system. We can develop the business software system for many different enterprises agilely in this way

articleTitle: Deferability Decision Model of Venture Investment Project
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Since venture investment can be deferred or not in practices, venture investment projects are classified into exclusiveness ones and competitiveness ones in this paper. With reference to option-game theory, the authors analyze their intrinsic value respectively and develop a decision model for each so as to determine deferability of these two types of projects

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Effect of Stock Prices on the Money Multiplier in China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This article first presents theoretical analysis on the channels through which the stock prices influence the money multiplier. Our study on the three influence channels, namely excess reserve ratio, the ratio of cash in circulation to checkable deposits and the ratio of the sum of savings and time deposits to checkable deposits is then verified by empirical analysis based on unit root tests and co-integration tests. By creating co-integration models and vector error correction models, we further examine both the short-term and the long-term effects of stock prices on the money multiplier. From the analyses we conclude that changes in stock prices can affect the effectiveness of macroeconomic policies in China by influencing the money multiplier which in turn influences the money supply. Therefore, this effect shall be taken into consideration in the decisions of future macro monetary policy

articleTitle: The Value of Production Outsourcing: A Real Options Perspective
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Production outsourcing is a good way to gain production flexibility and competitive advantage for manufacturers. This paper analyzes the value of production outsourcing and the effect of cost, product price and market demand on production outsourcing, which is considered as a series of European options. The manufacturer has the right to decide whether to outsource at each time interval. A discrete-time model in dynamic environment is designed to evaluate the options. In the model, manufacturing in-house and production outsourcing are supposed as two projects, and each one has its own value. If the value of outsourcing is bigger than that of manufacturing in-house, the manufacturer outsources its production. It's easy to make the decision in deterministic condition, but in dynamic environment it's not easy to do that. In this model, assuming there is no switching cost. And product price, market demand, cost of manufacturing in-house and cost of outsourcing are considered as the sources of uncertainty. Each of the four variables is assumed to follow a geometric Brown motion. Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate these variables. The value of manufacturing in-house and the value of outsourcing are obtained based on the simulation. The manufacturer holds the option to manufacture in-house or outsource according to the result. The effect of some key parameters (volatility of product price, volatility of market demand, volatility of manufacturing in-house cost, volatility of outsourcing cost, and the coefficients of correlation) on option value of production outsourcing is analyzed, and numerical results are given. The novelty of the paper is that four variables are included in the real options model and Monte Carlo simulation, and real options approach is proved as a useful tool to help make decision of production outsourcing. The results will help the manufacturers to decide their production outsourcing

articleTitle: Dynamic Appraisal Model for Supply Chain Performance Based on Extension Theory
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Measuring the performance of supply chain is a difficult task. The purpose of this paper is to provide a dynamic appraisal model for supply chain performance based on extension theory. The appraisal system of supply chain performance is represented by matter-element method and extension analysis in extension theory. The dynamic appraisal model for supply chain performance based on extension theory is created. Range of index value is depicted by classic region and segment region, relation function is used to do level appraisal. At last the feasibleness and maneuverability of model is verified by experiments. The model has the character of reflecting supply chain dynamically operation

Author Keywords: Appraisal model of supply chain performance

articleTitle: A Study on Structural Model for Strategic Transformation of Firms Based on Organization Learning
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Dynamic competition environment and firms' capabilities promotion require strategic transformation. Based on related studies, the article defines the conception of strategic transformation, constructs a structural model for strategic transformation of firms on the basis of organization learning. The model's ideas mainly include some aspects as follows: First, organization learning leads to strategic transformation, and strategic transformation increments organization performance. Second, organization learning enhances dynamic capabilities, and dynamic capabilities ensure strategic transformation of firms. Third, strategic implementation power of firms influences the promotion degree of organization performance resulting from strategic transformation. Fourth, organization learning and dynamic capabilities together strengthen strategic implementation power of firms. Finally, conclusions and directions for future research are discussed

articleTitle: Study on the Operating Strategy of China's Later-developing MNCs under the New Multi-National Relations
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This Paper, based on researching into the interrelations of MNC and multinational relationships, analyses the characteristics of the brand-new formation of Chinese MNC, namely, Later-developing Multi-national Corporations. Then, by combining the interrelations of MNC and multinational relationships given the context of globalization, it farther analyses the connotations and applicable managing strategies having been adopted and being currently and popularly adopted by China' later-developing multi-national corporations. Finally, based on the above mentioned analyses and drawn lessons in the advanced countries, some new managing strategies have been proposed for China's Later-developing Multi-national Corporations, aiming at not only improving the internationally mastery adaptabilities of China's MNC but also enhancing its competency in the international environment as well

articleTitle: Tunneling of Ultimate Controlling Shareholders in Pyramidal Ownership Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper, based on the data of Chinese family controlled listed corporations and the related party transactions from 2002 to 2004, empirically investigates the ultimate controlling shareholders' tunneling wealth out of the listed corporations by means of related party transaction in pyramidal ownership structure, and examines its effect on corporate valuation and the factors of inducement and constraints related to it. Compared with the research of direct ownership structure and recent literatures in China concerning tunneling, this paper's new finding is that, in the pyramidal ownership structure, the ultimate controlling shareholders do conduct tunneling by manipulating the related party transactions, and deteriorate the value of the listed corporations. Moreover, the tunneling is positively correlated to the divergence between ownership and control of controlling shareholders. In addition, the other large shareholders have constraints effect on the tunneling of ultimate controlling shareholder; however, there is not enough evidence to confirm that independent directors have the similar effect

articleTitle: FDI Technology Spillover Effect for Zhejiang Province - An Empirical Analysis on Industrial Level
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the performance discrepancy of foreign direct investment (FDI) in Zhejiang provincial industries, this paper utilizes industrial data of 2004 to analyze the technology spillover effect of FDI in Zhejiang province. The regressive result shows that, FDI has influenced the economic development of Zhejiang province through its technology spillover effect upon the domestic enterprises. The main channels of Zhejiang provincial technical spillover are technology gap effect, competition effect, industry concentration effect and industry linkage effect. This paper finally delivers strategies and policy advices arise from the analysis towards the regression result

articleTitle: Analysis on the Developing Trend of China's Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The financial system of the world's main developed countries is mixed management, which is the trend of the international financial development. China will thoroughly open its financial market till December, 2006. China's banking industry will face a lot of great shocks coming from foreign banks which engage in mixed management. In this financial globalization time, China's banking industry must go with the mixed management trend to improve its competitiveness. This article first introduces the history of mixed management in the world's main developed countries, then analyzes China banking industry's history, its status and the reasons why mixed management is the inevitable choice of China's banking industry, and at last, the author brings forward relative suggestions to mixed management of China's banking industry

articleTitle: The Analysis of Family Housing Choice Behavior Based on the Investigation of Six Cities, Zhejiang Provice
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a binary logit model and an ordered logit model to examine the factors affecting consumers housing purchase behavior and intention based on the housing research data of six cities, Zhejiang Province. As to housing consumption choice behavior, the result of binary logit model shows: first, a increase in family income and residential stability can make the probability of own go up. The probability of own can also rise when family is in the late of lifecycle or the rental market is more mature. While the fast increase of housing price reduces the probability of own. Using the binary logit model, the paper analyzes the affecting factors of family housing investment choice. The result shows, family income and residential stability are also the important factors to housing investment choice. The higher of the two factors is, the higher of housing investment's possibility will be. When rental market is mature, the probability of housing investment decreases. It indicates the purpose which most family buy more housing is to gain the short-term profit. Though the higher of rent-to-price of urban can make housing investment's possibility decrease, the affecting is weak. The paper also applies an ordered logit model to analyze the affecting factors of housing purchase intention. We find that if the households have not own housing or are not satisfied with current house service, the households will be more inclined to buy a home. Besides, the preference of owning increases with age and housing price. The conclusion also shows the expectation of trend of housing price is one of the most factors that can affect the housing purchase behavior. The intention of buying housing will be intense when consumers are optimistic to rise of housing price. The loan of residential mortgage improves the capability of households to afford a home. However, the effect of gongjijin residential loan is not significant

articleTitle: Activity Modes Selection in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider the activity modes selection problem in the project management, which is also called time-cost tradeoff problem. This problem is known as strongly NP-hard. We provide a lower bound on this problem by combing the dynamic programming method and the Lagrangian relaxation. Furthermore, we develop a method to obtain an upper bound by leverage the greedy algorithm. Later on, we combine the lower bound and upper bound method together to propose a feasible solution. In most of the problems generated in our experiments shows, the gap between the proposed solution and the exact solution (got by solving integer problem) is less than 1 percent

articleTitle: Relationship between Liability and Profitability of the Listed Companies in Petrochemical Industry: An Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the development of a company, reasonable and moderate liability can not only make up capital insufficiency, but also make better use of the financial leverage and improve the income ratio of rights capital. The petrochemical industry is one of the national economy pillars. Therefore, it is very important to investigate the relationship between liability and profitability of the listed companies so as to improve their capability to collect capital, make the best of financial leverage and optimize the capital structure. According to 157 petrochemical listed companies' annul report data from 2002 to 2004, this paper analyzes the liability condition of those listed companies and the relationship between liability and profitability by empirical investigation. The result shows: the financial performance of the petrochemical listed companies which in different liability range is obviously different; most of the companies whose liability/asset ratio below 40% generally had better financial performance, and the performance was also significantly higher than average; performance of the companies whose liability/asset ratio in 40%-60% is a little lower than the ones whose liability/asset ratio below 40%; and most of the companies in this industry generally choose the capital structure from 40% to 60%; performance of the companies whose liability/asset ratio over 60% declines significantly; the companies whose liability/asset ratio over 80% are almost suffering loss

articleTitle: The Choice of Competitive Priorities in Manufacturing Enterprise Based on the Trade-offs Theory
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: More and more manufacturing enterprise goes into global competition. It is important to make right strategies for competitive position. According to trade-off theory, most enterprises can't get all competitive priorities at the same time due to their inside and outside limitations. So, enterprises should decide the orders of competitive priorities according to their importance. They will focus on the most important competitive priorities. Different enterprise has different choices, and this paper aims for a research on trade-off theory and the choice of competitive priorities in manufacturing enterprise based on it. Data used in this article is from International Manufacturing Strategy Survey (IMSS, 1993-2001), which initiated by London Business School. Because the research in most literatures is general, this paper will investigate this question with different variables which include size, country, products, process types, customer orders and market demands. Through this paper, the author tries to answer the question: what kinds of competitive priorities should be chosen by the enterprise? The author also hopes this paper could provide a reference for the manufacturing enterprises to make competitive strategy

articleTitle: The Construction and Implementation of Assessment Indicator System of Suppliers Based on Fuzzy Integral
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The purposes of the current study are to analyze the factors influencing the selection of suppliers, develop the models of supplier assessment. For demonstration, an example is given to confirm the feasibility and flexibility of the proposed method and process. Since the criteria of cost, quality, and delivery are the most important factors for supplies buyers, how to evaluate the suppliers and choose the best one to build a long-term partnership has become a significant strategic selection for shaping competitive advantage for practitioners of industry. The study reviewed the relevant literature and conducted a survey on many supplies firms to collect data and develop the indicator systems and models for assessing eligible suppliers. By using fuzzy integral, we developed multicriteria system of assessment for the choosing of qualified supplier. Besides, the procedures through which the input and output of the data for selecting and assessing the candidate suppliers was implemented. The proposed method and process of supplier selection are with both theoretical value and practical contributions. They can significantly simplify the process of supplier selection and enhance the efficiency of purchasing as well as the quality of decision-making

articleTitle: The Research of Option Pricing on Mortgage Loan
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The author supposes lenders and borrowers possess identical information and similar beliefs about collateral future value. Using option-pricing techniques, we show that a secured loan contract is equivalent to a regular bond and an embedded option to the borrower to default. We finds that the lender will not advance to the borrower a loan that exceeds the market value of the collateral, and that the supply of loans increases with a rise in the market value of the collateral. Increases in the volatility of the value of the collateral, interest rate, and dividend rate of the collateral independently depress the loan supply

articleTitle: A Study of Impact on the Changes of Telecom Price Policy
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper tests abnormal returns of policy changes of telecom price, announcements issued by China Mobile and China Unicom, and rumors about unilateral charge on mobile communications. It is found that price policy changes gave more significant impact on China Unicom than China Mobile's, which was listed later. The impacts of announcements made by China Mobile are more significant than China Unicom's. But the event of unilateral charge on mobile communications does not have significant impact on the movements of these two companies. It is concluded that industrial policies have more distinct impact on the stock price of later listed company (i.e. China Unicom); while operating environment and the performance changes have more influence on the stock price of early listed company of China Mobile.

articleTitle: Effect of Patent Platform Strategy on Core Competence of Manufacturing Companies
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the knowledge-based times, the competition of intellectual property rights is the highest form in the existence and development of high-tech enterprises. At present Chinese economy develops fast. China has become one of the most important manufacturing industry bases in the world. Product platform and technology platform are the instrumental tools for manufacturing companies to develop and produce new products in the development of modern industry. And patent, as one of core technology resources, is of utmost importance to the development of high-tech manufacturing companies. If they can be combined into patent platform, manufacturing companies will gain sustainable, leading and fast advantages of R&D during the period of time competition of technological innovation. This will become the core competence of manufacturing companies in technology strategy consequently

articleTitle: Internalization Perspective Idea of Ecological Industry Policy Research Framework
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Externalities are one of causations of the ecological environment deterioration, and it makes the market resources allocation mechanism failure, it also brings difficulties to the government regulating and controlling economy. First, we revealed realization problem of the public policy analysis method based on the internalization. Thus, we expatriated ecological industrial reasonability based on internalization perspective. Finally, we proposed ecological industry policy framework and quantitative calculation idea based on the internalization calculation

articleTitle: Recombining Forecasts Used in Personal Credit Scoring
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Using the idea of combining forecasts, this paper presents a new approach by combining multi-linear regression and logistic with three different NNs. Then, recombine them with perceptron and apply it in personal credit scoring of one commercial bank. The results indicate that the combining methods are more accurate than either of the individual technology, and recombining is a reasonable way because it has greater precision than either the combining methods or pre-combining models, especially in avoiding recognizing the bad applications as good ones

articleTitle: The Measurement and Calculation of Elastic Coefficient in Cobb-Douglas Production Basing on the Same Kind Technology Level
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In allusion to the flaw confirmed by traditional fund output elastic coefficient and labor output elastic coefficient, the article measures and calculates the labor and capital elastic coefficient in Chinese different develop stages by using Cobb-Douglas production function model and selecting different period cross section data through grey cluster theory. And studies and analyze the measurement and calculation result. The article finds that: Elastic coefficient is different under vary periods and technology levels. Labor elastic coefficient of Chinese regional economics from 1981 to 2003 becomes bigger and bigger and capital elastic coefficient becomes smaller and smaller with the improvement of technique level, but the two contend basic relationship: alpha+beta=1. The article forecasts the change of labor and capital elastic coefficient with the technique level change

Author Keywords: Elastic coefficient of capital and labor

articleTitle: Perturbation Analysis for Studying the Bidding Strategy in Asymmetric First Price Auctions
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Bidders' asymmetries are widespread in auction markets. In such cases the mathematical model is given by a system of coupled nonlinear ordinary differential equations that cannot be solved explicitly for the equilibrium strategies, except for very simple models. As a result, analysis of asymmetric auctions is considerably more complex than for symmetric ones, and relatively little is known at present on asymmetric auctions. In situations like this, where it is difficult or even impossible to obtain exact solutions, much insight can be gained by employing perturbation analysis, whereby one calculates an explicit approximation to the solution. In this paper we adopt this approach and use perturbation analysis to calculate the equilibrium bid strategies in first price auctions. As we see, these explicit approximations are quite insightful, making the sacrifice of "exactness" worthwhile

articleTitle: Using Bivariate Probit Model to Analyze Bank Lending Policy
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper builds on the credit-scoring literature and proposes a method to evaluate the bank lending policy. We use the bivariate probit approach to estimate an unbiased scoring model. The data set with large commercial loans data provided by a commercial bank of China to estimate the model contains some financial and firm information on both rejected and approved applicants. In the bivariate probit model, we find a significant cross equation between loans rejected and loans granted. That means only uses loan granted data to develop a credit-scoring model will suffer from a sample-selection bias. Based on our unbiased results, the interest rate and other key variables have positive (negative) effects on the probability of granting a loan also have the same effect on the probability of default, implying that the bank adopt a lending policy prefers to risk minimization but not profit maximization

articleTitle: Transfer Price-based Money Laundering in International Trade
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper defines money laundering in the context of international trade and builds analytic models to measure the contribution of transfer prices to international money laundering. Money laundry-related transfer pricing and transfer price-based money laundering are analyzed in detail. It argues that transfer price-based capital flight and tax evasion are variants of money laundering in nature to the extent that they all enable the apparently legal ownership of the property shifted illegally. Our main contribution lies in the identification of the artificial transfer pricing (ATP) paradigm and integrating capital flight and tax evasion into the models to estimate its contribution to global money laundering pool, helping anti-money laundering (AML) policy-makers better understand the nature of transfer pricing and its negative impact upon the economy. It concludes that effective audit and inspection systems should be established in order to better detect suspicious money laundering transactions and prevent money laundering crimes (MLCs)

articleTitle: Research on the Factors Influencing Stability of the Supply Chain Cooperation Relationships
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the theoretical analysis of the factors influencing the stability of the supply chain cooperation relationships, we establish a theoretical model of the important factors which affect the stability of the supply chain cooperation relationships. After doing the investigation in the companies in the eastern and western China, we got 117 formal questionnaires. We use SPSS statistical software to do factor analysis and 5 key factors influencing the stability of the supply chain cooperation relationship are educed after rotating the 17 influencing factors. We also use regression analysis and find the respective effecting degrees to the stability of the supply chain by those 5 key factors. Then we point out that communicate and credit mechanism is the most important factor which affects the stability of supply chain cooperation relationship among all the factors, which provides positive sustentation for enhancing the cooperate relationship between the supply chain enterprises

articleTitle: A Theoretical Framework of the Governance Mechanisms in Network Organization
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The technological and economic cooperation among enterprises has promoted the birth of network organization, but the forming of network organization is just the necessary condition for the synergy effect. If the unique efficacy of network organization is made full use in resource allocation, network organization must be governed effectively. The core of network organization governance lies in the governance mechanisms. Only the mechanisms put in place, network organization would work in order. Based on the literature review and questionnaire data, this paper uses fuzzy cluster method to classify the governance mechanisms according to the macroscopic operating rule and microscopic running norm, thus the system of governance mechanisms is constructed.

articleTitle: Alternative Vehicle Fuels Strategy in China: Well-to-Wheel Analysis on Energy Use and Greenhouse Gases Emission
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Oil consumption and import of China increase very quickly in recent years. Because of vehicle population growing in a tremendous speed, nearly 40% of oil has already used in transportation sector in today's China.
