Many earlier studies argue that local knowledge spillovers is the main factors that influence innovative performance of firms operating within high-tech industry cluster, at the same time, absorptive capacity are also important. This paper investigates how a firm's absorptive capacity (ACAP) mediates the impact of knowledge spillovers on innovation performance of firms operating within high-tech industry cluster. Our basic hypothesis is that those firms with higher absorptive capacity, not only identify more knowledge spillovers; they are also able to manage them more efficiently, and ultimately transform them into innovative outcome. The date comes from questionnaires of 102 firms in Changchun software industry cluster in China. As a result of this study, we do find empirical support that absorptive capacity mediates the impact of knowledge spillover on innovative performance of firms within high-tech industry cluster

articleTitle: Constructing Models of Knowledge Management in Research Teams
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Continually extended scientific research needs more cooperation among different disciplines. An outstanding research team needs to develop a set of management models to support effective management. Knowledge management, as a completely new management model and management theory, has been successfully applied to knowledge organizations in enterprises and has formed a set of relatively perfect theoretical methods. This paper firstly sets up a model of dynamic harmonious cooperation among research teams according to their characteristics and a frame model of knowledge management based on the analysis of similarities and differences between knowledge organizations in enterprises and research teams. Then it presents the application of knowledge management into the process of research projects in detail. Finally, it discusses the learning mechanisms of individuals in a research team as well as of the whole team to improve the team's abilities of learning, applying, researching and developing

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of KIBS: Contribution to Regional Economic Comparison
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper addresses the development status of KIBS, basic content. KIBS (Knowledge Intensive Business Services) in the urban development feasibility and importance expresses that the services sector is not only a knowledge of the inevitable result of the economic growth but is also a prerequisite for sustained economic growth. Empirical analysis of the three cities Beijing, Shanghai, Wenzhou as a target has proved the importance of the knowledge of the services sector to economic development, and ultimately to the knowledge-based service industry's rate of contribution to the economy as the starting point for Wenzhou development of knowledge-based service industries related responses

articleTitle: The Employees' Scale of Real Estate Business and Its Perspective Research
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of gray system theory which is applied in the prediction of HR from the macro angle and according to the related information of real estate employees from 1989 to 2004 in China, the paper predicts the demands for HR in 2006 and tests the result based on the actual situation by the gray GM (1,1) model. If that the average relative error is comparatively small, it will show the perspective accuracy is comparatively large. Meanwhile, the paper performs quantitative analysis toward rational scale of employees on the basis of mandatory and agent model from the micro angle, thus establishes a practical scale model of enterprise' employees

articleTitle: The Amendatory Mundell's Substitution Model of Investment and Trade
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Mundell studied the relationship between foreign direct investment and trade and concluded that one country's collection customs duties on import productions will stimulate the inflow of the factor and substitute trade completely at last. In this paper, through validation of the Mundell's model by supposing the production possibilities frontier is a conic function, we find what Mundell had found was an exceptive point, which only when the country produced specialization. The true equilibrium point should be one point in the Rybcznski line between the first production equilibrium point and the upward point of the first consumer equilibrium point on the Rybcznski line, which is not the upward point of the first consumer equilibrium on the Rybcznski line. At the same time, the welfare of the host country will increase when the host country collects tariff

articleTitle: The Research on Measuring Method of Real Estate Bubble
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Recently, because of the rapid development of Chinese real estate industry, the problem of the existence of real estate bubble attracts more attention of the society than ever. In fact the essence of the existence of Chinese real estate bubble struggle is the interest struggle of different interest groups. When Chinese real estate bubble emerges and bursts at last, it will bring serious result to the whole economy and society. The bubble has been one important restricting factor of the healthy and steady development of Chinese real estate industry. Thus it is necessary to have a widely recognized and practical testing and measuring method of real estate bubble to judge the existence of bubble. But after analysis and comparing of many testing and measuring methods of real estate bubble, the author find that they only could test whether bubble exists or not but could not measure the size of it. So, this paper through the rational stock bubble model which put forward by American famous economist Blanchard and Wosoton in 1982 establishes the testing and measuring model of real estate bubble to cover above disadvantages. The formulation of real estate bubble model is simple as compared with other methods and the data needed in model can be acquired easily. Moreover the model is highly adaptive and expansible. At last we make empirical research into real estate industry of several big cities with the conclusion that the degree of the bubble in Shenzhen housing residences is the largest about 102.8% and the average degree of the bubble in housing residences reaches 34.4%, which illustrates clearly that not only there is bubble but also it is very big now in Chinese real estate market. The measuring model lays the foundation for the construction of early-warning system and provides reference for the government decision

articleTitle: Process and Preliminary Results in the Construction of Product Categories Based WOM Source Selection Scale
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This research is aimed at constructing a valid scale measuring WOM source selection based on Product categories. According to the research model on the basis of product categories, customer perceived risk, and customers' Word-of-Mouth source selection, the WOM source selection scale is composed by three subscales, that is product category, perceived risk and WOM source. In the pretest, six kind of goods/services have been chosen to represent three product categories, perceived risk subscale is constructed with six dimensions and WOM source subscale is constructed with two dimensions, Item analysis on each subscale has been done to show that the whole scale is validate and reliable

Author Keywords: Product categories based WOM source selection scale

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Dividend Policy Factors of Listed Corporation of Our Country
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: How to adopt a reasonable dividend policy to make corporation's value maximize is an important problem needing solving in company's finance and management. The dividend policy of a company is determined together by all kinds of factors, such as legal limitation, contractual limitation, industry factor, inner management, shareholders' inclination and tax law etc. There are some concrete indexes: currency capital, profit for shareholder to distribute, amount of capital stock, percentage of tradable shares, earning per share, capital reserve. This text chooses 60 listed corporations in China in 2004 as samples and adopts correlation method and linear regression in empirical study on their dividend policies. The aim is to probe into relations between different policies and research on how these factors influence dividend policies

articleTitle: Improvement and Application of Quality Profit Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: There had been many researches about the best quality cost in the world. Early research generally focused on the cost of quality. They thought that the cost input would increase and the failure cost would go down with the quality level rising. So they thought the point of the lowest cost was the best quality level. Because customers require better product quality and companies want to achieve the greatest efficiency in the modern competitive market. It's necessary to combine quality cost with quality revenue and establish mathematical models on the basis of the relations of quality costs or revenues and quality levels and finally consider the quality profit as the final criterion to select the best quality level. The quality profit model in this article overcomes the defects in traditional models that seeing the lowest total cost as the best decision and the defects in the "zero error" theory that seeing "q=1" as the best quality level and improves the relationship between quality cost and quality level. This model, better in line with total quality management (TQM) in modern production environment, can guide the total quality management more efficiently

articleTitle: Demand Uncertainty and Supplier's Buybacks in the Price Dependent Newsvendor Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper considers a price dependent newsvendor model where a risk-neutral supplier sells its product to a risk-neutral retailer facing price dependent consumers. Consumers' demand formulation is derived from micromodeling of consumer utility functions and captures demand uncertainty regarding two parameters: market size and price sensitivity. The paper analyzes how the nature of demand uncertainty affects decisions of the supplier and the retailer. Furthermore the supplier may induce the retailer facing uncertain demand to carry ample stocks of their products by agreeing to buy back unsold goods for credit. The paper considers under which condition a buyback contract can be offered by the supplier to validly coordinate the newsvendor model and under which condition a buy back contract cannot be adopted to deal with the channel conflict induced by uncertainty

articleTitle: Pour une Recherche Action en Management Territorial
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Dans des pays complexes comme la Chine et la France, les pratiques territoriales sont essentielles pour garantir un développement économique équilibré, en tenant compte des ressources et des spécificités locales. La recherche action et la recherche intervention sont des méthodologies appropriées pour comprendre les pratiques en cours, analyser leur sens et mieux les orienter vers les besoins ou les opportunités du terrain. C'est aussi un moyen d'étudier la médiation des collectivités territoriales pour une meilleure régulation en matière culturelle, économique et sociale. La décentralisation effective est difficile mais nécessaire aussi bien en Chine qu'en France, car ce sont des pays centralisateurs, dont les politiques historiques ont été orientées vers la déconcentration soumise et pas vers la délégation authentique de sphères de pouvoirs. Au delà des poussées économiques observables, un développement durable exige de s'appuyer sur la totalité des forces territoriales, avec une autonomie des acteurs qui sera d'autant plus nécessaire qu'on ira vers une créativité par les connaissances, une innovation par les initiatives personnelles et des foyers de compétences collectives à gouvernance interne.

articleTitle: An Affine Structure Model with Considering the Negative Correlation between Default Probability and Recovery Rate
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: An affine structure model to price defaultable coupon bond was proposed in this paper. The model considers the negative correlation between default probability and the recovery rate. By constructing a characteristic function and solving the corresponding Riccati equations, the closed-form solution of the pricing model was gotten. The parameter sensitivity analysis indicates that the proposed model can produce abundant credit spread term structures and that the risk of recovery rate is certainly a systematic risk factor which can bring risk premium. At last, the empirical research selected four corporation bonds on Shanghai stock exchange to test the model. The results indicate that the recovery rates of these bonds are all very high and the hazard rates are all very low which are consistent with the real condition that these bonds are all high rating bonds. And the matching of market price and theoretical price demonstrates the validity of the model

articleTitle: Study on Consumer's Kansei Image Evaluation for High-tech Consumable Products
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a systematical study of critical Kansei image evaluation words of high-tech consumables. By means of analysis and measurement of Kansei image of high-tech product formation, designing investigation, semantic differential method and statistical analysis of data, it is proposed that the psychological Kansei image of consumers should be explored with the mode of quantitative analysis and multiple regression equation be established between product Kansei image and degree of preference, so that the objective of Kansei image identification of high-tech electronic consumable product design would be achieved. This can also be used as a reference for consequent product design. The Mp3 products are taken as an example to illustrate, it is shown that: product characters, such as modern, masculine, technological, delicate, can greatly increase consumer's general satisfaction, while elegant, novel, bright contribute little to product image. Therefore, enterprises should pay special attention to establish such product characters as technological, modern, etc

articleTitle: Research on Compounding & De-Compound-Based Portfolio Operation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Investment is a continuous process, the portfolio is impossible to be constructed at one time, thus it needs to be adjusted and optimized at the right moment during the investment process. The thesis applies compounding & de-compound to the portfolio optimization, has designed the portfolio optimization project, and established a model which can optimize the portfolio continuously in the investment process. In the end, this idea and program was used to testify the real efficiency in index of SSE 50 (index of Shanghai stock exchange)

articleTitle: The Development of Brand Relationships Index Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: There is some problem about indicator system in most current researches of brand relationships evaluation. It is necessary to create a new method. Four brand relationship partners and three brand relationship natures are put forward to make up of a hypothesis of twelve-dimension brand relationships. Through a series of empirical studies, a five-dimension indicator system is obtained. Indicator weights are calculated by the path coefficients. Based on indicators and their weights, brand relationship index model is advanced

articleTitle: Mechanism Designing of Multi-unit Combinatorial Online Double Auction
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Combinatorial (double) auctions have recently been used in business-to-business trading of centralized marketplace or other multi-agent coordination systems. When the goods are indivisible, winner determination problem (WDP) can be described as an integer-programming model and NP-hard in its general form, so a novel multi-round combinatorial double auction mechanism is proposed to solve it. A multi-objection integer programming is set up to study special properties of online combinatorial double auctions so as to search for the optimal solutions of the model. Comparing to previous researches on double auction, the combinatorial double auctions mechanism expatriated shows some advantages in respect that running for several rounds to matching bids as more as possible and permitting agents applying online learning algorithms to adjust bidding strategy adaptively to pursue more bargain opportunities. Agents trade identical bundles of goods with discriminatory prices, which embodied the diversity and flexibility of practical market. Result of a typical example shows that the mechanism increased the overall revenue and improved market efficiency greatly relative to single-round combinatorial (double) auctions

articleTitle: "Double Purchase" in the Transition Process to a New Incompatible Technology
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the problem of "double purchase" that may occur during the transition process between old technology and new incompatible technology. When network externalities are important and converters are unavailable, some consumers will join both networks in order to reap the benefits of compatibility. It also generates some negative factors simultaneously. Our model posts when these negative factors will affect the new technology owner's incentive of making "double purchase" realistic for consumers. The findings also show why some special dual-module combo products emerge in the transition process.

articleTitle: The Road Map to KM Evaluation in Organization: A Holistic Framework
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge Management (KM) has the real staying power and the potential to become the significant and permanent part of management's tool box. However, many organizations failed to realize the potential of marrying Information & Communications Technology (ICT) and KM theory to build Knowledge Management System (KMS). To meet the benefits from KM to expectations and reach KMS to its real potential, it is seriously needed to establish the evaluation and measurement framework for KMS. Based on metrics identified in literature, this paper proposes a holistic evaluation framework and a evaluation matrix, which provide a road map to KM evaluation in organization, and are applicable to plan the assessment of KM and systems holistically and effectively in organization

articleTitle: Research on Return Mechanism of Supply Chain Based on Cooperation Game Model
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A kind of return mechanism of supply chain based on Nash negotiation model is proposed firstly. Although the optimal equilibrium solution of this model can satisfy the individual rationality and collectivity rationality of cooperation game, supplier and retailer allocate the increased benefit of supply chain averagely unconditionally under the optimal equilibrium solution of this model. To overcome the equalitarian phenomena, a further kind of return mechanism of supply chain based on asymmetric Nash negotiation model according to the former model is proposed. The most remarkable character of the further model is that the cooperation contribution rates of supplier and retailer are considered into the model. And the cooperation contribution rates of supplier and retailer are measured by Shapley value of cooperation game theory

articleTitle: Economic Adjustment Analysis Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This study is based on Neural Networks approach trained from the input and output data of economic system as samples. The analytical data used in this study is from Beijing Statistical Yearbook. After normalizing the data to meet the training requirement and using the method of neural network ensemble, the net which represents the inter-relationship between input and output items of the economic system has been built. By altering input items, observing the effects on output items, we made an analysis for economy adjusting. And the constraints according to the real contradictions between the input items are set in the simulation process. Then by changing the specific two items which constitute a couple of contradiction within a proper range, we observed the developing trends of the output items. The results show trends of output items are reasonable, and several useful conclusions has been draw

articleTitle: Investment Style of China's Fund and Its Influence on Fund Performance
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The investment style is a hot topic of fund analysis nowadays. Applying the return based style analysis (RBSA, introduced by Sharpe in 1988, 1992), this paper presents an empirical analysis of China's fund style analysis and corresponding performance evaluation. Compared with previous studies which were single performance analysis or single style analysis in China, there are some new explorations in the paper. We use a new model to combine the two fields. The other new development is that we construct a useful hypothesis test method in the study, which makes a scientific criterion to evaluate the results of fund style analysis. From the study of 51 close-end funds operating in the time period from January, 2000 to December, 2003, we found that fund performances showed a parentally regulative pattern when the investment style effects were taken into account. The difference of funds performance results from the differences of the fund investment style. Better performanced funds adopted positive investment policies; while worse performanced funds employed more balanced passive investment policies. The asset allocation or the fund style accounts for 83.9% and 82.8% of funds performance in the bull market and the bear market respectively. Fund styles changed much from the bull market to the bear market. In the bull market, investment styles of mutual funds were growth type investing in large-cap and growth stocks, while in the bear market, investment styles were more balanced primarily investing the bond or cash assets

articleTitle: Research about the Correlation among Nonaudit Service Pricing, Audit Fee and Audit Independence - Coming from the Empirical Data in the Stock Market of China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: People have paid close attention to the correlation among nonaudit service pricing, audit fee and audit independence. Taking listed companies (issuing A share) that disclosed audit fee and nonaudit fee in annual report during the period from 2001 to 2004 as the object of study, and using audit opinion and tenure as the substitution variables of audit independence, we firstly approach the correlation among nonaudit service pricing, audit fee and audit independence. The conclusion of empirical research shows: the significantly positive correlation between audit fee and nonaudit fee, the negative correlation between nonaudit fee and audit tenure, and the positive correlation between nonaudit fee and standard audit opinion which have no statistical significance. No evidence shows that audit independence has the significant effect on nonaudit service pricing

articleTitle: Demand Disruption Management for Supply Chain System with Quantity Discount Contract
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: For a one-supplier-one-retailer supply chain who faces stochastic market demand, it can be coordinated with quantity discount contract. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the supply chain that experiences a demand disruption during the planning horizon. First, we show that the coordination may be broken off by an emergent event, which make the demand disruptions, that is, it makes the demand distribution different from the assumption needs to achieve original supply chain's coordination. Second, we show that changes to the original plan induced by an emergent event may impose considerable deviation costs throughout the system and make the supply chain uncoordinate. We derive conditions that indicate when the maximum profit can be achieved. Then, an optimal strategy for supply chain to the disruptions by quantity discount contract is presented. Last, an adjusted quantity discount contract which has antidisruption ability is proposed, and it can be used as an effective scheme to coordinate supply chain in a large range of situations

articleTitle: Harmony Configuration and HeXie Management: An Empirical Examination of Chinese Firms
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on a HeXie Management perspective, theoretical hypotheses are advanced which argue that for harmony configuration, there are significantly many simultaneous changes among the variables of environment (E), organization (O), leadership (L) and strategy (S). Tested by the data from 149 Chinese firms, the academic research supports the hypotheses. Samples comprised of successful firms show a higher percentage of significant correlations among changes in EOLS variables than do samples comprised of unsuccessful firms. Firms may be required to align their EOLS in a manner that ensures the congruence among the elements. And the results reinforce the need to the further study of the relationship between the congruence of HeXie and performance in organizations

articleTitle: A Note on Tax Competition and Leviathan
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The central purpose of this paper is to determine the effect of interjurisdictional competition for capital on public decisions of Leviathan-type policymakers who are also concerned with re-election. We show that the supply of public goods is (in)efficient in a Nash-equilibrium when such policy-makers (do not) use freely their tax instruments. Moreover, tax instruments choices depend on the assumption concerning capital ownership. When the local stock of capital is owned by residents, policy-makers are not likely to use the tax on capital while absentee ownership leads them to use it as tax exporting allows them to increase their rents

articleTitle: A General Evaluation on the International Competitiveness of Automobile Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Chinese automobile industry is now on a stage of rapid development. It is necessary to make its development blueprint from a global view. Based on a practicable evaluation system, the paper makes positive analysis on the international competitiveness of domestic manufacturers, thereby to provide a distinct description of internationalization of Chinese automobile enterprises

articleTitle: Evaluation on Enterprises Technological Innovation Ability: An Integration Synthesis Model Based on Back Propagation Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Technological innovation is the power engine for business and enterprise development. Objective and scientific assessments on enterprises' technological innovation abilities have their impact on business operation strategies and their operation system establishment. This assessment involves the formation of assessment indexes and a selection of scientific evaluation methods. For better overall and objective assessment concerning technological innovation capabilities, this paper brings qualitative indexes, such as business culture and decision makers, into the assessment system so that an artificial neural network comprehensive assessment model is established, reflecting complicated non-linear relations among various internal indexes inside business enterprises

articleTitle: An Application of Process Layout Design Method to Service Operation of Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper explores the key issues in mass customization of service operation with special concern on layout planning by employing the process layout design approach in a case study of Chinese restaurant. Findings are given in terms of three perspectives: Firstly the integration of analysis both in product and process is proven to be critical in layout arrangement of mass customization. Secondly the impacts of the modular production should be seriously taken into account when the process layout design method is used in mass customization operation. Finally the paper stresses that key features of services should also be incorporated for better solutions to the layout problems by especially identifying the influences brought by the customer participation in the service delivery

articleTitle: Research of the Evaluating Method for Commercial Bank Operation Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Commercial bank is a special kind of company with the character of high risk and high indebted. For this particularity, it must keep a certain scale and take "safety, payoff and fluency" as the management principle. Lately, Chinese commercial banks develop quickly, but the operation efficiency is in the lower level. We can take the appropriate evaluating and analyzing method to ameliorate the lacks of the existing method, establish the efficient index system, and analyze the operation efficiency of Chinese commercial banks.

articleTitle: Long-term Forecast of Chinese Urban Residential Average Per Capita and Stratum Subdivision Estimation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Applicable "multi-model weight number generating integration method" has been proposed based on the gray forecast model. articleTitle: Working Values of Chinese Business Managers: An Empirical Research Based on Motivational Domains
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In Knowledge economy era, corporate culture plays much more important roles in breaking through the bottleneck of physical capital development in business. Business managers could not overlook the power of corporate culture have in gaining competitiveness. The core of corporate culture is the value system, which has influence on orientation and cohesiveness. Based on the general human value model developed by Shalom H. Schwatz and Wolfgang Bilsky, we study the working value of Chinese business managers, and identify the working value of Chinese business managers from motivation domains perspective and conduct the CFA of 7 dimensions model under the China cultural environment. Finally, we discuss how the results of the study could explain the managerial behavior and decision-making process of Chinese business managers under both traditional culture and open-door policy influence
